Always expand early and build if safe.
Always defend home and border when attacked or outnumbered.
Always talk and propose to ally with neighbors early.
Always keep promises and tell the truth to allies.
Always trust allies unless betrayed.
Expect others to lie sometimes; distrust players who break promises or lie.
Always punish players who attack or betray you.
Never forgive betrayal unless needed to survive or balance against the leader.
Always support allies when safe and needed.
Never betray allies early.
Only betray an ally late if they are the leader or if needed to win.
Always attack and balance against the leader late.
Avoid attacking weak players unless needed for gain or to survive.
If threatened, defend and warn before attacking.
Once strong, expand and hold centers until you win.
